rules.title: Left-hand drive (LHD) only
rules.rule_text: The UAE registers left-hand-drive vehicles only. Right-hand-drive vehicles are generally not permitted for private registration unless converted to LHD.

rules.title: No general age limit
rules.rule_text: There is no universal age limit for importing used cars into the UAE, but vehicles must meet GCC specification and older vehicles may require additional approval in some emirates. Confirm with official customs before trading.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: GCC specification required
rules.rule_text: Imported vehicles should conform to GCC (Gulf Cooperation Council) specification. Non-GCC-specification vehicles may require modification before registration.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: EV incentives
rules.rule_text: The UAE offers incentives for electric vehicles including public charging programs and toll exemptions in some emirates. Confirm current EV import requirements with official customs before trading.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: Left-hand drive (LHD) only
rules.rule_text: Saudi Arabia is a left-hand-drive market. Vehicles must be LHD to be registered.

rules.title: Used passenger car age limit (5 years)
rules.rule_text: Saudi Arabia generally restricts import of used passenger cars to those no older than five years; heavy vehicles may have different limits. Confirm with official customs before trading.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: SABER / SASO conformity
rules.rule_text: Imported vehicles require SASO conformity and registration on the SABER platform before shipment.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: EV adoption incentives
rules.rule_text: Saudi Arabia is promoting EV adoption through charging infrastructure and fee exemptions. Confirm current EV import rules with official customs before trading.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: Right-hand drive (RHD) only
rules.rule_text: Kenya is a right-hand-drive market. Vehicles must be RHD to be registered under KS 1515.

rules.title: 8-year age limit
rules.rule_text: Kenya limits import of used motor vehicles to those not older than eight years, enforced under KS 1515:2000. Confirm the exact cut-off with official customs (KRA/KEBS) before trading.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: Pre-shipment inspection (PVoC)
rules.rule_text: Used vehicles require a Pre-Export Verification of Conformity (PVoC) certificate before export to Kenya.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: EV duty relief
rules.rule_text: Kenya applies a reduced import duty and exempts electric vehicles from excise duty under the EAC Common External Tariff. Confirm current rates with official customs before trading.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: Right-hand drive (RHD) only
rules.rule_text: Tanzania is a right-hand-drive market. Vehicles must be RHD to be registered.

rules.title: Age limit (about 8-10 years)
rules.rule_text: Tanzania restricts import of used vehicles by age, commonly around eight to ten years. Confirm the current limit with official customs (TRA) before trading.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: Pre-shipment inspection (PVoC)
rules.rule_text: Used vehicles require a Pre-shipment Verification of Conformity (PVoC) through the Tanzania Bureau of Standards before import.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: EV incentives
rules.rule_text: Tanzania has introduced incentives to encourage EV imports, including reduced excise on electric vehicles. Confirm current policy with official authorities before trading.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: Right-hand drive (RHD) only
rules.rule_text: Nigeria is a right-hand-drive market. Left-hand-drive vehicles are generally not permitted for registration.

rules.title: Vehicle age restriction
rules.rule_text: Nigeria restricts import of used vehicles by age, and the rules have changed in recent years. Confirm current limits with official customs (Nigeria Customs Service) before trading.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: Pre-shipment inspection (SONCAP / Form M)
rules.rule_text: Used vehicles are subject to Nigeria's import clearance and pre-shipment inspection requirements (SONCAP / Form M). Confirm current procedure with official customs before trading.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: EV policy developing
rules.rule_text: Nigeria's EV import policy is developing, with discussion of duty relief for electric vehicles. Confirm current rules with official customs before trading.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: Left-hand drive (LHD) only
rules.rule_text: Kazakhstan is a left-hand-drive market. Right-hand-drive vehicles are generally not permitted.

rules.title: Vehicle age limit (recently adjusted)
rules.rule_text: Kazakhstan applies an age limit to imported used vehicles, which has been adjusted in recent years. Confirm the current limit with official customs before trading.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: EAEU technical regulations
rules.rule_text: Imported vehicles must comply with EAEU (Eurasian Economic Union) technical regulations and certification.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: EV duty exemption
rules.rule_text: Kazakhstan has temporarily exempted electric vehicles from customs duty and recycling fee to promote adoption. Confirm current status with official customs before trading.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: Left-hand drive (LHD) only
rules.rule_text: Uzbekistan is a left-hand-drive market. Vehicles must be LHD to be registered.

rules.title: Strict import controls
rules.rule_text: Uzbekistan applies strict controls on vehicle imports, including certification and recycling fees. Confirm current requirements with official customs before trading.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: Vehicle age restrictions
rules.rule_text: Uzbekistan has historically restricted used vehicle imports by age. Confirm current limits with official customs before trading.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: EV import duty & excise exemption
rules.rule_text: Uzbekistan exempts electric vehicles from import duty and excise tax to encourage adoption. Confirm current rates with official customs before trading.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: Right-hand drive (RHD) only
rules.rule_text: South Africa drives on the left and registers right-hand-drive (RHD) vehicles. Left-hand-drive vehicles are generally not registrable for private use.

rules.title: ITAC import permit required
rules.rule_text: Used/second-hand vehicles may only be imported with an International Trade Administration Commission (ITAC) import permit. Permits are restricted mainly to returning South African nationals, permanent-residence immigrants, racing cars, vintage, specially designed and inherited vehicles.

rules.title: NRCS Letter of Authority + Interpol clearance
rules.rule_text: SARS requires, for a second-hand vehicle import to be legal: customs clearance documents, a Letter of Authority from the National Regulator for Compulsory Specifications (NRCS), an ITAC import permit, and an Interpol clearance certificate.

rules.title: No fixed age limit (restricted categories)
rules.rule_text: South Africa has no hard age cut-off for used vehicles, but imports are restricted to defined permit categories (returning residents, immigrants, special-purpose vehicles). Confirm current ITAC permit eligibility before sourcing stock.
rules.notes: Permit categories are restrictive — verify eligibility with ITAC before purchase.

rules.title: EVs face 25% import duty (no relief)
rules.rule_text: Electric vehicles attract the same 25% passenger-vehicle import duty (higher than the 18% ICE rate in some classifications); there is no EV-specific import-duty relief in South Africa.
rules.notes: Confirm current HS 87 duty classification with SARS before purchase.

rules.title: Left-hand drive (LHD) only
rules.rule_text: Egypt drives on the right and registers left-hand-drive (LHD) vehicles. Right-hand-drive vehicles are not registrable — typical RHD Japanese used cars cannot be imported or registered.

rules.title: Used cars near-new (about 1 year); EVs up to 3 years
rules.rule_text: Egypt restricts used passenger-car imports to near-new units (about one year old), while electric vehicles up to three years old are permitted under the 2025 EV policy.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with Egyptian Customs before purchase.

rules.title: NAFEZA single-window clearance
rules.rule_text: All vehicle shipments must clear through the NAFEZA single-window system; import licence, certificate of conformity and proof of payment via authorised banks are required.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with Egyptian Customs before purchase.

rules.title: EV import duty exemption (0%)
rules.rule_text: From 1 January 2025 Egypt exempts pure-electric vehicles (BEV, HS 8703.80) from customs duty (0%), with a progressive FOB-value deduction up to 50%. Individuals may import one EV every five years.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with Egyptian Customs before purchase.

rules.title: Left-hand drive (LHD) only
rules.rule_text: Jordan drives on the right and registers left-hand-drive (LHD) vehicles.

rules.title: EV age cap of 3 years
rules.rule_text: Under rules effective 1 November 2025, electric vehicles more than three years old (including the year of customs clearance) may no longer be imported.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with Jordan Customs before purchase.

rules.title: Salvage / damaged vehicles banned
rules.rule_text: Vehicles classified as salvage or junk — including fire-, flood-damaged or unrepairable units — may no longer be imported into Jordan.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with Jordan Customs before purchase.

rules.title: EV special tax unified at 27%
rules.rule_text: Under the 2025 Special Tax Bylaw (announced 28 June 2025), special tax on electric vehicles is unified at 27% for all categories, versus 51% for petrol and 39% for hybrid vehicles.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with Jordan Customs before purchase.

rules.title: Right-hand drive (RHD) only
rules.rule_text: Pakistan drives on the left and registers right-hand-drive (RHD) vehicles.

rules.title: Cars up to 3 years (personal schemes)
rules.rule_text: Under the Personal Baggage, Gift and Transfer of Residence schemes, used cars not older than 3 years and other vehicles not older than 5 years may be imported. The commercial-channel 5-year age cap was removed from 1 July 2026 (SRO 1065/2026).
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with FBR before purchase.

rules.title: Personal Baggage / Gift / Transfer of Residence schemes
rules.rule_text: Used vehicles are imported by overseas Pakistanis under the Personal Baggage, Gift or Transfer of Residence schemes only; duty is a fixed US-dollar schedule by engine capacity (e.g. US$13,200 for 1001–1300cc).
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with FBR before purchase.

rules.title: EV duty concession (25% up to US$50k)
rules.rule_text: Electric 4-wheelers valued up to US$50,000 are taxed at 25% customs duty; hybrid electric vehicles up to 1800cc receive a 50% duty exemption (25% for 1800–2500cc).
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with FBR before purchase.

rules.title: Right-hand drive (RHD) only
rules.rule_text: Bangladesh drives on the left and registers right-hand-drive (RHD) vehicles.

rules.title: Reconditioned-car age restrictions
rules.rule_text: Bangladesh imports reconditioned (used) vehicles under NBR rules with age and condition restrictions; duty is a compounding cascade of customs duty, supplementary duty, VAT, advance income tax and regulatory duty.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with NBR before purchase.

rules.title: Pre-export inspection required
rules.rule_text: Reconditioned vehicle imports require pre-export inspection and standard documentation (invoice, bill of lading, certificate of origin).
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with NBR before purchase.

rules.title: PHEV / EV duty reduction
rules.rule_text: Bangladesh has proposed import-duty cuts on plug-in hybrid electric vehicles as part of its energy-efficiency strategy; EV/PHEV duty treatment is evolving.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with NBR before purchase.

rules.title: Left-hand drive (LHD) only
rules.rule_text: Chile drives on the right and registers left-hand-drive (LHD) vehicles.

rules.title: No import age limit
rules.rule_text: Chile has no import age limit for used vehicles, making it one of the most flexible markets in Latin America.
rules.notes: Confirm current SNA customs rules before ordering used units.

rules.title: RUT + standard documents
rules.rule_text: A Chilean tax identification number (RUT) is required; clearance needs the invoice, bill of lading, certificate of origin and export certificate.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with Chile Customs before purchase.

rules.title: No EV-specific duty relief
rules.rule_text: Chile applies a flat 6% ad valorem duty regardless of powertrain; no EV-specific import-duty relief is recorded. Chinese EVs have strong market presence.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with Chile Customs before purchase.

rules.title: Right-hand drive (RHD) only
rules.rule_text: Thailand drives on the left and registers right-hand-drive (RHD) vehicles. China-market LHD units cannot be registered as-is; source RHD export units.

rules.title: Used-vehicle imports tightly restricted
rules.rule_text: Thailand heavily restricts used-vehicle imports. Regular used passenger-car imports are generally not permitted for private registration; only new cars and limited special categories (classic vehicles 30+ years, returning residents) may qualify. Verify current rules with Thai Customs.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with Thai Customs before purchase.

rules.title: Import permit (Department of Foreign Trade)
rules.rule_text: New-vehicle imports require an import permit from the Department of Foreign Trade and conformity with Thai emissions and safety standards. Confirm the full permit and clearance procedure before shipping.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with Thai Customs before purchase.

rules.title: EV 3.5 package (excise 8%→2%)
rules.rule_text: Under the EV 3.5 package, battery-electric passenger cars priced up to 7 million baht receive an excise-tax reduction from 8% to 2%, and CBU EV imports during 2024–2025 benefit from reduced import duty. Confirm current rates with Thai Customs/BOI.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with Thai Customs before purchase.

rules.title: Left-hand drive (LHD) only
rules.rule_text: Vietnam drives on the right and registers left-hand-drive (LHD) vehicles — which rules out the large RHD used-car pipelines of Japan and Thailand and favors China-sourced LHD units.

rules.title: 5-year age limit (Decree 116/2017)
rules.rule_text: Under Decree 116/2017/ND-CP, imported used passenger cars must generally be no more than 5 years from the year of manufacture — a firm cutoff, not a guideline. In 2026 this means roughly model-year 2021 and newer.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with Vietnam Customs before purchase.

rules.title: Type approval + used-car surcharge
rules.rule_text: Imported vehicles require type approval and technical safety inspection; used combustion cars also face a fixed mixed-duty surcharge on top of import duty, special consumption tax and VAT. Confirm documents and the surcharge with Vietnam Customs.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with Vietnam Customs before purchase.

rules.title: EV incentive (0% duty + 3% SCT)
rules.rule_text: Electric vehicles enjoy 0% import duty and a reduced 3% special consumption tax under the current incentive window (running into early 2027) — a structural advantage over combustion used imports.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with Vietnam Customs before purchase.

rules.title: Right-hand drive (RHD) only
rules.rule_text: Indonesia drives on the left and registers right-hand-drive (RHD) vehicles.

rules.title: Used-car imports effectively prohibited
rules.rule_text: Indonesia effectively prohibits the import of used (second-hand) vehicles — only new completely built-up (CBU) units may be imported under an importer licence (API) with type approval, and even those are restricted to protect local assembly.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with Indonesian customs before purchase.

rules.title: CBU EV duty exemption (until Dec 2025)
rules.rule_text: Indonesia exempted CBU battery-electric cars from import duty and reduced the luxury-goods sales tax (PPnBM) until 31 December 2025; the Industry Ministry has announced the CBU EV incentive will not continue in 2026.
rules.source: Schinder Law Firm / Indonesia Industry Ministry
rules.notes: CBU EV incentive ends Dec 2025 — verify current status with Indonesian customs.

rules.title: Left-hand drive (LHD) only
rules.rule_text: Mexico drives on the right and registers left-hand-drive (LHD) vehicles.

rules.title: Eight-year rule for definitive used import
rules.rule_text: Used passenger cars imported as definitive imports generally must have a model year within the last eight years; older units face additional hurdles, higher taxes or prohibition. Border-zone temporary import programs have their own age windows.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with Mexican customs (Aduanas/SAT) before purchase.

rules.title: NOM conformity (emissions & safety)
rules.rule_text: Definitively imported vehicles must satisfy Mexican Official Standards (NOM) for emissions and safety; US/Canada-origin vehicles follow the border and decree procedures. Confirm the applicable NOM conformity path before shipment.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with Mexican customs before purchase.

rules.title: No EV-specific import-duty relief recorded
rules.rule_text: No EV-specific import-duty relief is recorded for Mexico; imported vehicles face standard duty plus 16% IVA. Mexico has separate EV market incentives, but these do not reduce used-vehicle import duty.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with Mexican customs before purchase.

rules.title: Right-hand drive (RHD) only
rules.rule_text: Ghana drives on the left and registers right-hand-drive (RHD) vehicles.

rules.title: 15-year age limit (from 1 Oct 2026)
rules.rule_text: Under the Ghana Standards Authority's National Vehicle Homologation and Conformity Assessment Programme, effective 1 October 2026, used vehicles older than 15 years are refused entry; vehicles 10–15 years old may attract overage penalties. In 2026 this means roughly model-year 2011 and newer.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with GSA before purchase.

rules.title: Pre-shipment inspection + Certificate of Conformity
rules.rule_text: Every used vehicle must be inspected in its country of origin by a GSA-approved inspection organisation before shipment; a cleared unit receives a Certificate of Conformity confirming safety, quality and environmental compliance.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with GSA before purchase.

rules.title: EV import-duty reduction (developing)
rules.rule_text: Ghana has moved to reduce import duty on electric vehicles as part of its energy-transition policy; EV duty treatment is evolving and should be confirmed with the Ghana Revenue Authority before trading.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with GRA before purchase.

rules.title: Left-hand drive (LHD) only
rules.rule_text: Peru drives on the right and registers left-hand-drive (LHD) vehicles.

rules.title: 5-year age limit (2 years for diesel)
rules.rule_text: Peru limits used-vehicle imports to 5 years old for spark-ignition (petrol) vehicles and 2 years old for compression-ignition (diesel) vehicles; age is counted from the year of manufacture to shipment date.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with SUNAT before purchase.

rules.title: Ad valorem + ISC + IGV layered taxes
rules.rule_text: Vehicle imports face ad valorem CIF customs duty, selective consumption tax (ISC) on duty-inclusive value, and general sales tax (IGV 17%) plus municipal promotion tax (IPM 2%) on the cumulative base. Clearance is via the Unique Customs Declaration (DUA).
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with SUNAT before purchase.

rules.title: No EV-specific import-duty relief recorded
rules.rule_text: No EV-specific import-duty relief is recorded for Peru; EVs are subject to the same ad valorem duty and IGV/IPM as combustion vehicles. Confirm current treatment with SUNAT.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with SUNAT before purchase.

rules.title: Left-hand drive (LHD) only
rules.rule_text: The Philippines drives on the right and requires left-hand-drive (LHD) vehicles. Importing a right-hand-drive (RHD) vehicle is a criminal offence under Republic Act No. 8506.

rules.title: Used-vehicle imports generally prohibited (NDI exceptions)
rules.rule_text: Under EO 156 as amended by EO 877-A, import of used motor vehicles is generally prohibited. Limited exceptions exist under the No-Dollar Importation (NDI) program for returning residents (≥1 year abroad), immigrants (13g/13a visas), and diplomats. The vehicle must be owned and registered ≥6 months, one unit per family, and cannot be resold for 3 years.

rules.title: EV zero import duty (EO 12, extended to 2028)
rules.rule_text: Executive Order No. 12 (s.2023) temporarily zero-rates import duty on electric vehicles, parts and components; the NEDA Board extended it to 2028 and broadened it to cover hybrid electric vehicles (HEVs) and plug-in hybrids, removing the previous 30% duty on hybrids/PHEVs.
rules.source: HKTDC Research / Bureau of Customs CMC 64-2023
rules.notes: Temporary measure extended to 2028 — verify current status with the Bureau of Customs.

rules.title: Left-hand drive (LHD) only
rules.rule_text: Iraq drives on the right and requires left-hand-drive (LHD) vehicles. Non-armored vehicles only; salvage, flood- and fire-damaged units are not admitted.

rules.title: Used-vehicle age limit (about 5 years)
rules.rule_text: Iraq applies an age limit to used-vehicle imports, commonly cited around 5 years; some import guides report a stricter 2-year limit. Rules are enforced per entry point and change frequently — confirm the exact cut-off with the Umm Qasr agent / Iraqi customs before sourcing stock.
rules.notes: Sources conflict (5-year vs 2-year limit) — verify with Iraqi customs before purchase.

rules.title: Original Bill of Lading + vehicle identifiers
rules.rule_text: Vehicles must ship with the original Bill of Lading showing chassis number, engine number, cubic capacity, year of manufacture, brand, make and model. Duty varies by vehicle category and engine size, and by entry port (Umm Qasr, Basrah/Khor Al Zubair).
rules.source: Auto Beats LLC / One Roof Autos (Iraq import policy)
rules.notes: Duty varies by category and engine size — verify current schedule with Iraqi customs.

rules.title: No EV-specific import policy documented
rules.rule_text: No dedicated EV import-duty relief has been identified in the sources reviewed; EVs are treated under the standard variable duty schedule. Confirm EV treatment with Iraqi customs before trading.
rules.notes: EV treatment not documented in reviewed sources — verify with Iraqi customs.

rules.title: Left-hand drive (LHD) required
rules.rule_text: Ethiopia drives on the right and requires left-hand-drive (LHD) vehicles.

rules.title: EV-only import policy (petrol/diesel banned since Feb 2024)
rules.rule_text: Since February 2024 Ethiopia only allows the import of electric vehicles, banning petrol and diesel cars entirely. Combustion-engine used vehicles are not eligible for import or registration.
rules.notes: Policy change frequently cited; confirm current status with the Ethiopian Customs Commission.

rules.title: Used-vehicle age limit (about 5 years)
rules.rule_text: Used EV imports are subject to an age limit, commonly cited around 5 years (with 1–3 years preferred for quality). Age is counted from year of manufacture.
rules.notes: Age-limit figures vary by source — verify with Ethiopian customs before purchase.

rules.title: Original Bill of Lading + vehicle identifiers
rules.rule_text: Vehicles must ship with the original Bill of Lading showing chassis number, engine number, cubic capacity, year of manufacture, brand, make and model. Ethiopia is landlocked — vehicles transit via the Port of Djibouti.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with Ethiopian customs before purchase.

rules.title: Left-hand drive (LHD) only
rules.rule_text: Colombia drives on the right and requires left-hand-drive (LHD) vehicles.

rules.title: Used vehicles generally not importable (new / current-year only)
rules.rule_text: Colombia generally restricts permanent import to brand-new vehicles (current year, 0 km). Used vehicles cannot be imported by non-diplomats; exceptions cover diplomats and classic/collector cars over 35 years old under special approval. Change-of-residence and free-zone regimes have separate rules.

rules.title: 1-year age limit (permitted categories)
rules.rule_text: For the limited categories that may import used vehicles, a 1-year age limit (from year of manufacture) generally applies. Used-vehicle imports are prohibited outside change-of-residence, diplomatic and free-zone regimes.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with DIAN before purchase.

rules.title: EV incentive (≈5–7% combined vs 35%+19% for ICE)
rules.rule_text: Colombia applies significant tax relief to electric vehicles — combined import taxes are reported around 5–7% of CIF for EVs, versus about 64–70% for combustion vehicles. The relief applies to new units; used-vehicle import remains prohibited.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify EV treatment with DIAN.

rules.title: Left-hand drive (LHD) only
rules.rule_text: Morocco drives on the right and requires left-hand-drive (LHD) vehicles.

rules.title: 5-year age limit + Euro 6 emissions
rules.rule_text: Imported used vehicles must be less than 5 years old at the moment of import and meet the Euro 6 emissions standard.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with Moroccan Customs (ADII).

rules.title: Euro 6 conformity + standard documents
rules.rule_text: Vehicles must conform to Moroccan safety and environmental standards (Euro 6) and clear through Moroccan Customs (ADII) with invoice, bill of lading and certificate of origin.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with ADII.

rules.title: No EV-specific import-duty relief documented
rules.rule_text: No dedicated EV import-duty relief has been identified in the sources reviewed; EVs are subject to the same customs duty and VAT as combustion vehicles. Confirm EV treatment with ADII before trading.
rules.notes: EV treatment not documented in reviewed sources — verify with ADII.

rules.title: Right-hand drive (RHD) only
rules.rule_text: Sri Lanka drives on the left and registers right-hand-drive (RHD) vehicles. China-market LHD units cannot be registered as-is.

rules.title: Vehicle imports reopened (1 Feb 2025)
rules.rule_text: Sri Lanka lifted its multi-year vehicle import suspension effective 1 February 2025 under the Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations No. 01 of 2025 (Gazette Extraordinary No. 2421/04). Eligibility is determined under the new framework.
rules.notes: Regime changes frequently — verify current eligibility with Sri Lanka Customs.

rules.title: EV excise calculated per motor kW
rules.rule_text: Sri Lanka levies excise on electric vehicles per motor kilowatt (rather than per cc of engine displacement), under the February 2025 regime. EV duty treatment is distinct from combustion vehicles.
rules.notes: Rates change frequently by gazette — verify with Sri Lanka Customs.

rules.title: Left-hand drive (LHD) only
rules.rule_text: Turkey drives on the right and registers left-hand-drive (LHD) vehicles.

rules.title: Layered tax: customs duty + ÖTV (SCT) + VAT
rules.rule_text: Imported vehicles face a compounding stack — 10% customs duty, a Special Consumption Tax (ÖTV/SCT) that dominates the landed cost (90–100% for ICE engines up to 1600cc, up to 220% above 2000cc), then 20% VAT on the cumulative base. Chinese-origin petrol and hybrid vehicles attract an additional 50% tariff (raised from 40% in January 2025).
rules.notes: ÖTV/SCT brackets change frequently — verify with the Turkish Ministry of Trade before purchase.

rules.title: No universal age limit identified
rules.rule_text: No single universal used-vehicle age limit was identified in the sources reviewed; the import cost burden is driven by the ÖTV/SCT tax stack rather than an age cut-off. Confirm current used-vehicle eligibility with Turkish customs before sourcing stock.
rules.source: Needs verification (no explicit age rule located)
rules.notes: Used-vehicle eligibility not clearly documented — verify with Turkish customs.

rules.title: EV SCT (ÖTV) reduced brackets (25–75%)
rules.rule_text: Under Presidential Decision No. 10115 (24 July 2025), electric vehicles are taxed on a four-bracket Special Consumption Tax: 25% (≤160 kW and pre-tax price ≤1,650,000 TL), 55% (≤160 kW above the price threshold), 65% (>160 kW below threshold), 75% (>160 kW above threshold) — versus 90–100%+ for combustion engines. PHEVs are taxed at 45–85%.
rules.source: LenaCars (EV SCT brackets) / Presidential Decision No. 10115
rules.notes: Brackets depend on motor power and pre-tax price — verify with the Ministry of Trade.

rules.title: Right-hand drive (RHD) only
rules.rule_text: Malaysia drives on the left and registers right-hand-drive (RHD) vehicles. China-market LHD units cannot be registered as-is; source RHD export units.

rules.title: Approved Permit (AP) required
rules.rule_text: Used-vehicle import requires an Approved Permit (AP) issued by MITI under the Customs Act 1967. APs are restricted and priority is given to franchise holders; private used-vehicle import is heavily constrained.
rules.source: Ministry of Investment, Trade and Industry (MITI)
rules.notes: AP eligibility is restrictive — verify current AP requirements with MITI.

rules.title: Used-car age limit (1–5 years, AP-dependent)
rules.rule_text: Used imported vehicles generally carry a maximum age of about 1–5 years depending on the AP category. Age is counted from first registration to shipment month.
rules.notes: Age limit varies by AP category — verify with RMCD (Royal Malaysian Customs).

rules.title: EV import duty & excise relief (until 31 Dec 2025)
rules.rule_text: MITI grants temporary import-duty and excise relief on fully electric cars and motorcycles (until 31 December 2025), with an on-the-road price floor of RM100,000 for cars. The relief is not subject to the equivalent-engine-capacity condition. Confirm whether it has been extended for 2026.
rules.source: Ministry of Investment, Trade and Industry (MITI)
rules.notes: Temporary measure — verify current status (2026) with MITI.

rules.title: Right-hand drive (RHD) required
rules.rule_text: New Zealand requires right-hand-drive (RHD) vehicles. LHD vehicles cannot be registered except classics 20+ years old or under a Special Interest Vehicle (SIV) permit.

rules.title: No fixed age limit (standards-based)
rules.rule_text: New Zealand has no fixed age limit for used-vehicle imports; eligibility is instead set by emissions standards (models from ~2005 onward) and frontal-impact compliance (mandatory for MA/MB/MC vehicles built from October 2003).
rules.notes: Standards-based, not age-based — verify current standards with NZTA.

rules.title: Entry certification + biosecurity
rules.rule_text: Imported vehicles require NZTA entry certification by an approved inspector, MPI biosecurity clearance (heat treatment/fumigation for brown marmorated stink bug during September–April), and pre-shipment inspection (e.g. JEVIC).
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with NZTA and MPI.

rules.title: Clean Car Standard CO₂ charge (up to NZ$2,875)
rules.rule_text: New Zealand applies a Clean Car Standard CO₂ charge on high-emission imports (up to NZ$2,875; used cars calculated at half the new-car rate). Zero-tailpipe EVs do not incur the CO₂ charge, but pay 15% GST. Passenger cars are otherwise duty-free (0% customs duty).
rules.notes: CO₂ charge tiers change — verify current rates with NZTA / Waka Kotahi.

rules.title: Left-hand drive (LHD) only
rules.rule_text: Algeria drives on the right and registers left-hand-drive (LHD) vehicles.

rules.title: Used cars under 3 years old
rules.rule_text: Since 2023 Algeria has authorized individual import of used cars less than three years old. Under the 2025 Finance Law, imported cars under three years old may now be resold, but the tax benefits must be repaid on a sliding scale (100% if sold within 12 months of clearance, 66% within 12–24 months, 33% within 24–36 months).
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with Algerian Customs (DGD).

rules.title: Safety equipment mandatory (ABS, airbags, speed limiter)
rules.rule_text: Imported vehicles must meet minimum safety standards including ABS and a speed limiter; vehicles over 1.2 litres additionally require two front airbags, headrests for all seats, windscreen/rear-window defrosters and child-seat anchors.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with Algerian Customs.

rules.title: EV import-tax reduction (up to 80% personal channel)
rules.rule_text: Algeria applies import-tax reductions to electric vehicles — reported up to 80% on the personal-import channel (50% for petrol/hybrid up to 1800cc) under the 2025 regime. Customs duty is otherwise 15% (petrol ≤1800cc) or 30% (≥1800cc and EVs).
rules.notes: Reduction % varies by channel — verify with Algerian Customs.

rules.title: Left-hand drive (LHD) only
rules.rule_text: Qatar drives on the right and registers left-hand-drive (LHD) vehicles under the GCC specification framework.
rules.source: Left- and right-hand traffic (Wikipedia) / Expat Focus

rules.title: 5-year age limit
rules.rule_text: Vehicles over 5 years old are prohibited from import into Qatar. Imports require a valid Qatar ID (residence permit) and Qatari driving licence.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with Qatar Customs.

rules.title: GCC specification required
rules.rule_text: Imported vehicles must conform to GCC (Gulf Cooperation Council) specification. Required documents include proof of ownership, registration certificate, purchase invoice, original Bill of Lading and prior insurance.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with Qatar Customs.

rules.title: No EV-specific import-duty relief recorded
rules.rule_text: No EV-specific import-duty relief was identified for Qatar in the sources reviewed; the flat 5% customs duty applies to all vehicles. EV adoption is supported through infrastructure rather than duty relief.
rules.notes: EV treatment not documented in reviewed sources — verify with Qatar Customs.

rules.title: Left-hand drive (LHD) only
rules.rule_text: Azerbaijan drives on the right and registers left-hand-drive (LHD) vehicles.

rules.title: 10-year age ban (Decree No. 94)
rules.rule_text: Since 28 April 2023 (Cabinet Decree No. 94), Azerbaijan bans the import of passenger cars manufactured more than 10 years ago — in 2026 that means model-year 2016 and newer. Every imported car must also have ABS, at least one airbag, and meet Euro-4 or higher emissions.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with the State Customs Committee.

rules.title: Engine-cc excise + 18% VAT (no flat duty)
rules.rule_text: Azerbaijan levies an engine-capacity-based customs duty plus an engine-cc excise tax and 18% VAT (charged on CIF + excise). From January 2026, cars older than 7 years pay a higher excise coefficient (petrol 1.5×, diesel 2.0×). Clearance is via the Baku Single Window.
rules.notes: Excise is engine-cc based, not a single rate — verify with the State Customs Committee.

rules.title: EV ≤3yr: 0% duty, no excise, but 18% VAT
rules.rule_text: Electric vehicles three years old or newer pay 0% customs duty and no excise, but since 1 January 2026 are subject to 18% VAT like all other cars.
rules.notes: EV incentive applies to ≤3-year-old units — verify with the State Customs Committee.
